## Install

1. Download **Canvas-*.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **Canvas** onto **Applications**.
3. Open Canvas. macOS will say it can't verify the developer: Canvas is free and open
   source, and isn't signed with a paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**, then go to
   **System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
   You only need to do this once.

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel.
